violations.title: Cooling from 135F to 41F, No More than 6 Hours
violations.observation: The following cooked time/temperature control for safety food(s) are not being adequately cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours and to 41F within a total of six hours: observed garlic fried rice in 2 door upright at 47-50F (>6 hours).
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety foods shall be cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours and to 41F within a total of six hours to prevent the growth of harmful bacteria. Foods that have been temperature abused are to be discarded. PIC discarded batch of rice. EHS discussed proper cooling methods with PIC.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Food-Contact Surfaces, Hard Wood
violations.observation: Wood or wood wicker is used in contact with food. Observed bamboo cutting board used in facility.
violations.corrective_action: Wood and wood wicker may not be used as a food-contact surface unless the wood is hard maple or close-grained and used for cutting boards, cutting blocks, bakers' tables, and utensils such as rolling pins, doughnut dowels, salad bowls, and chopsticks. EHS discussed proper use of wood as a food contact surface, including use of hard maple. PIC removed bamboo cutting boards from facility.

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed that the wall near stove separating kitchen from front counter is not maintained in good repair.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. Please repair wall.

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment were not observed sanitized: utensils, dishes washed in dish machine.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. PIC set up sanitizer basin at 3 compartment sink with appropriate chlorine concentration to sanitize all dishes.

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: observed the chemical dish machine with 0 PPM of chlorine.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. Please contact technician to repair dish machine. During inspection, PIC set up 3 compartment sink to wash dishes.

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed that the wall at cook line is not maintained in good repair. Observed hole in ceiling above the dish machine.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. Please repair hole in the wall by next routine inspection.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: waffle and wrapper mix (with raw egg) stored above cooked garlic rice in 2 dr upright unit.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. PIC placed waffle and wrapper mix below all ready to eat foods.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Sanitizers, Criteria
violations.observation: The concentration of the Bleach solution was measured at 500 ppm. This concentration exceeds the approved limits for use with food-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils in a foodservice establishment. EHS observed sanitizer at 500ppm
violations.corrective_action: Maintain the concentration of @SANITIZER@ solution at @##@ppm. Verify concentration using the appropriate test kit. PIC diluted sanitizer solution to 200 ppm

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: EHS observed ice machine dirty to sight and touch
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. Spoke to PIC about issue
